`auth.localhost` doesn't resolve in this environment. On a typical system `*.localhost` resolves to 127.0.0.1, but here it doesn't. This affects the backend's ability to reach Keycloak for JWKS. This is an environment/DNS concern.

But wait, how does the frontend work then? Browser would resolve auth.localhost to... the browser on the host machine. Actually the guide says Keycloak is at http://auth.localhost:3000. Browsers resolve *.localhost to loopback per spec. But the backend process running on the host also needs to resolve it.

Let me check the JWKS provider implementation to understand exactly.
